description:
Pride Month Tour in Collaboration with The History Project

Join Boston’s LGBTQ+ archives for a special edition of the Charlie Gibson Queer Boston tour. These two intimate Pride Month tours (15 guests each) include a bonus look at the Barrett exhibition, and a post-tour wine & cheese reception hosted in the garden-level with THP staff.
what_is_included:
- Tours of the Gibson House Museum
- Post-tour reception
